impacts.title: A Long, Tortured History of Airlines Trying to Win LAX
impacts.summary: There are dominant airlines in nearly every airport in the US, even those that are the most competitive. You have Delta at LaGuardia and JFK, United at Newark and Chicago/O’Hare, Alaska in Seattle, and the list goes on. But there is one airport that nobody has ever been able to conquer, and that’s Los Angeles...

impacts.title: The Spirit is Gone
impacts.summary: In the past, we’ve seen airlines seemingly shut down out of nowhere. Spirit was not that airline. After years of declining fortunes, the airline went through two bankruptcy stints and a near-herculean effort by its management team to save the airline. In the end, the pioneer of the ultra low cost model in the US...
